notes.title: Update v7 - Customize sounds and preview images!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

I hope you have a great Sunday! In this patch you get:

1. You can now customize both large and small preview images of cards, 

It works like this, if you name the file "card0x" where 0 is card ID, this file will be used as a large image, If you name the file "card0p" this file will be used as a small preview image 


2. Customize battle sounds! 

You can also customize the sounds, just put the file in Streamin Assets folder and name them: sound1.wav, sound2.wav and sound3.wav

4. The background battlefield image will now fill the whole screen

5. You can now customize the AI name, too

Thank you for your support!

ANPAUS

notes.title: Update v4 - custom music, avatar and background!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

With this udpate you can use following features:

1. Use you custom music during battles

Just copy your custom music to StreamingAssets folder and name it "music.wav".

For now it only process WAV files. 

2. Update your avatar

Just copy your custom artwork to StreamingAssets folder and name it "avatar.png"

It should 153x153 size to match the other elements. 

3. Update battlefield background

Just copy your custom artwork to StreamingAssets folder and name it "background.jpg".

Enjoy your battles!

ANPAUS

notes.title: Update v3 - Add you own cards!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

With this update you can use following features: 

1) Modify turn time and maximum deck size 

In StreamingAssets folder, you can find file: game_properties.json

Modify the line: "turnDuration": 90

In this case turn will last 90 seconds.

2) Add you own cards and cards sets

In StreamingAssets folder, you can find file: card_library.json

You can modify existing cards properties or just add new cards or whole cards sets. 

The syntax of the file is pretty simple and the easiest way to add new cards, is to just copy one the cards sets. 

[b]Just make sure that every card has unique "id" number.[/b]

You can also just play with the file and modify existing values of cards.

3) Zoom funtion is now available during gameplay, so you can right click on cards on your hand and experience their beauty in full screen. 

Thank you for your support!

ANPAUS

notes.title: Update Cards with your Own Artwork!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

I just rolled out an update with following features:

1. You can now replace the game cards artwork with your art.

Here is how to do it: 
a) Next to your executable, where the game is installed, you can find a folder ending with "_Data".

b) Inside that folder is another folder called StreamingAssets

c) If you copy an image inside this folder and name it "card" + CARD ID +"x"

it will replace the given card artwork. So for example for first card the name of the file will be: 

card0x.jpg

d) If you want to play with original artwork, just delete all files from SteamingAssets folder. 

As the file will be loaded during runtime, try to keep file size small so to avoid lags. I will try to improve the performance in next updates!

2. SteamWorkshop support

When you are happy with your local artwork, you can submit it to SteamWorkshop, so that everybody can download it and play your set of cards!

Thank you for your ideas on how to improve the game!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33087407/83c3c93132b6ba2701aa4f598be5888682b3c648.png[/img]
ANPA.US

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
Hello All!

I see you had bad experience with this game and I just want to state that I hear you All. 

Goind through the reviews and some feedback on the forum, I added following features to the game: 

- Zoom option to get a close up view on the card and the artwork associated wih it

- simple leveling system, where you unlock more cards by progressing and winning games (both online and local games) 

- more cards (12 cards, now in total 24)

Our artist is already working on more cards, which will be released in next update. 

I am not sure if we should add more hentai styled artwork or just keep this at ecchi style. Let us know what you think. 

Thank you for your constructive feedback, hopefuly, with your help, this game will get better. 

Stay hard ehhmm, I mean strong.
